jsesh.mdcDisplayer.mdcView
Class RelativePosition

java.lang.Object
  jsesh.mdcDisplayer.mdcView.RelativePosition
public class RelativePosition
extends java.lang.Object

RelativePosition represent position of a view relatively to either the previous view or its parent view.

Author:
rosmord This code is published under the GNU LGPL.

Constructor Detail

RelativePosition

public RelativePosition(float dx,
                        byte xAnchor,
                        float dy,
                        byte yAnchor)
Build a RelativePosition.

if anchors are set to "PREVIOUS", the corresponding dimension is relative to the previous view. The other value correspond to positions relative to the parent view.

The coordinate system is always oriented in the usual way : x axis rightward and y axis oriented downward.

Parameters:
dx - horizontal coordinate.
xAnchor - one of WEST, EAST or PREVIOUS
dy - vertical coordinate.
yAnchor - one of NORTH, SOUTH or PREVIOUS
